```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Data: set SHEET_URL in R/ecoflor_submissions.R (or env ECOFLOR_SHEET);
# without it the example data in submission_pipeline/ are used.
source("R/ecoflor_submissions.R")

contributions <- read_contributions()
orals <- contributions %>% filter(Final_format %in% TALK_FORMATS)
posters <- contributions %>% filter(Final_format == "Poster")

render_abstract <- function(row, label) {
  cat("### ", md_escape(row$Title), " {#", tolower(row$Submission_ID), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("[", label, " · ", row$Submission_ID, "]{.smallcaps}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(format_authors(row$Authors, row$Presenter), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("::: {.small}\n", format_affiliations(row$Affiliations), "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(format_abstract(row$Abstract), "\n\n", sep = "")
  kw <- keywords_of(row)
  if (length(kw)) cat("*Keywords:* ", paste(md_escape(kw), collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("---\n\n")
}

render_block <- function(data, label_fun) {
  for (sid in unique(data$Session_ID)) {
    sess <- data %>% filter(Session_ID == sid)
    cat("\n## ", sess$Session_Name[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(sess))) render_abstract(sess[i, ], label_fun(sess[i, ], i))
  }
}
```

# Welcome {.unnumbered}

Welcome to ECOFLOR 2027 in Prague! This book contains the abstracts of all oral and poster presentations, ordered as in the programme. Presenting authors are underlined.

The meeting is organised by researchers at the [Faculty of Science, Charles University](https://www.natur.cuni.cz/eng) in cooperation with the [Česká společnost pro ekologii](https://www.cspe.cz/) (ČSPE) and the [Asociación Española de Ecología Terrestre](https://www.aeet.org/) (AEET).

`r nrow(orals)` oral presentations · `r nrow(posters)` posters

\newpage

# Oral presentations

```{r}
#| results: asis
render_block(orals, function(row, i) if (row$Final_format == "Rising Star") "Rising Stars talk" else "Talk")
```

\newpage

# Posters

```{r}
#| results: asis
poster_no <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(posters)), posters$Submission_ID)
render_block(posters, function(row, i) paste("Poster", poster_no[[row$Submission_ID]]))
```

\newpage

# Keyword index

```{r}
#| results: asis
kw_index <- contributions %>%
  select(Submission_ID, Keyword_1, Keyword_2, Keyword_3) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Submission_ID, values_to = "Keyword") %>%
  filter(Keyword != "") %>%
  group_by(Keyword) %>%
  summarise(ids = paste0("[", Submission_ID, "](#", tolower(Submission_ID), ")", collapse = ", ")) %>%
  arrange(Keyword, .locale = "en")
cat(paste0("**", md_escape(kw_index$Keyword), "** — ", kw_index$ids, collapse = "\\\n"), "\n")
```

# Author index

```{r}
#| results: asis
author_index <- contributions %>%
  mutate(author = map(Authors, ~ parse_authors(.x)$name)) %>%
  select(Submission_ID, author) %>%
  unnest(author) %>%
  group_by(author) %>%
  summarise(ids = paste0("[", Submission_ID, "](#", tolower(Submission_ID), ")", collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(surname = word(author, -1)) %>%
  arrange(surname, author, .locale = "en")
cat(paste0(md_escape(author_index$author, italics = FALSE), " — ", author_index$ids, collapse = "\\\n"), "\n")
```
